chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said:
The most beloved of the food to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was Al-Narbaja.
ai.seo_question: What was the most beloved food to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi’s chapter on cuisine highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) preference for Al-Narbaja, widely identified by Shia scholars as a pomegranate-based dish or gravy, reflecting the simplicity and natural flavors of the prophetic diet. It serves as a practical example of the Sunnah in culinary matters, emphasizing moderation and the enjoyment of permissible foods without extravagance. The chain of transmission through Yunus ibn Ya'qub, a prominent companion of Imam al-Rida, underscores the reliability of this dietary tradition within Shia hadith corpus.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub who said,
‘The most beloved of the food to Rasool-Allahsaww was Al-Narbaja (Pomegranate gravy)’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub who has said the following: “He (the Imam) has said, ‘
The most desirable food to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, was al-Nar Bajah (broth made of pomegranate).”’
